expressions.name: fpa_amount
expressions.expr: next((c['amount'] for c in level1['charges'] if c['type'] == 'fpa'), 0.0)

expressions.name: last_year_units
expressions.expr: next((x['units'] for x in extras['usage_history'] if x['month'] == 'SEP25'), 0.0)

expressions.name: diff
expressions.expr: level1['units_consumed'] - next((x['units'] for x in extras['usage_history'] if x['month'] == 'SEP25'), 0.0)

expressions.name: summer_units
expressions.expr: sum(x['units'] for x in extras['usage_history'] if x['month'] in ['JUN26', 'JUL26', 'AUG26'])

expressions.name: winter_units
expressions.expr: sum(x['units'] for x in extras['usage_history'] if x['month'] in ['DEC25', 'JAN26', 'FEB26'])

expressions.name: diff
expressions.expr: sum(x['units'] for x in extras['usage_history'] if x['month'] in ['JUN26', 'JUL26', 'AUG26']) - sum(x['units'] for x in extras['usage_history'] if x['month'] in ['DEC25', 'JAN26', 'FEB26'])

expressions.name: unpaid_months
expressions.expr: [x['month'] for x in extras['billing_history_rows'] if x['amount_paid'] < x['amount_billed']]

expressions.name: same_month_last_year
expressions.expr: next((x['units'] for x in extras['usage_history'] if x['month'] == 'SEP25'), 0.0)

expressions.name: avg_monthly_bill
expressions.expr: sum(x['amount_billed'] for x in extras['billing_history_rows']) / len(extras['billing_history_rows'])
